task.description: TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR gate (WF-02 Step 3b) PASSED on rework-1 recheck, plus the mutation-testing pass that was explicitly deferred from the original (pre-fix) review. Recheck: TEST-DESIGNER's fix replaced `actor_id: nil` with `actor_id: Ecto.UUID.generate()` in the three named tests ('AC2 level 2'/'AC2 level 3'/'AC2 level 4', test/letflow/routers/instances_test.exs) -- `actor_id: nil` violated the events table's `null: false` constraint and Letflow.EventStore.Event.insert_changeset/2's @required_fields, so Repo.insert failed before any assertion ran, exactly as the original FAIL diagnosed. Confirmed via `git diff` between the prior and reworked commits that only those 3 lines changed, nothing else in the file. Independently re-ran `mix test test/letflow/routers/instances_test.exs` myself: 44/44 passed, 0 failures. Since this is a genuine fix landing on top of already-existing, already-passing code (not a WF-03 'module did not exist pre-fix' case), mutation testing against a broken baseline was not blocked -- I additionally applied 4 of TEST-DESIGNER's mutant classes directly to lib/letflow/instances.ex myself, one at a time in a throwaway edit, ran the full file's suite, confirmed the expected AC test(s) failed, then reverted and re-confirmed `git status --porcelain lib/ test/` was empty before applying the next: (a) collapsed resolve_actor_display_name/3's cond to skip the token_description/actor_label clauses and jump straight to "system" -- caught by AC2 level 2 and level 3 (41/44, both failed with the expected wrong string); (b) dropped the `Map.has_key?/2` guard so a present-but-unresolved actor_id calls `Map.fetch!/2` unconditionally -- caught by AC3's dedicated deleted-user test (34/44 failed, KeyError on the un-found key, among others); (c) broke N+1 avoidance by moving the actor lookup inside the per-event Enum.map so each event issues its own single-actor query instead of one batched query over the page's distinct actor_ids -- caught by AC7's telemetry-counted query-count test (43/44 failed: 'expected exactly one, got 6'); (d) swapped TASK_COMPLETED's render_description/3 clause body for INSTANCE_STARTED's -- caught by AC4's exact-string assertion (43/44 failed on the wrong sentence). All four mutants were caught by the acceptance-criteria test(s) they were designed to guard, all four were reverted, and `git status --porcelain lib/ test/` was empty after each revert and again after the final run (confirmed 44/44 clean). Also independently reran mix compile --warnings-as-errors (clean), mix format --check-formatted (clean), and mix letflow.lint_handoffs (0 new violations, 25 pre-existing grandfathered per ISS-0190). Routing to TEST-RUNNER per WF-02 Step 4 for the formal run + report.
acceptance_criteria: Run `mix test test/letflow/routers/instances_test.exs` (and the full suite per your own role's scope) and report real, quoted pass/fail counts -- do not trust this handoff's reported 44/44 without re-deriving it yourself.
Confirm no test in this file is skipped (`@tag :skip`) and none depend on execution order or shared hardcoded fixture state.
If the full suite surfaces any unrelated failure, apply Failure Attribution Is Structural, Never By Count-Matching (core-directives.md) before calling it pre-existing.
Produce your standard structured TEST-RUNNER report and route onward per WF-02 (RELEASE-VALIDATOR next).
CRITICAL: this handoff's top-level status field is exactly PENDING (grepped and confirmed before commit, per this project's own recurring anti-pattern on this exact mistake).
